changes_made.explanation: Removed overly verbose output descriptions and consolidated to simpler terms. Removed model variant specifications (3-layer, 6-layer) as these are implementation details, not distinct models. The core NLG task is semantic parsing.
Normalized all variants to standard 'Exact Match' metric name. The paper consistently uses exact match as the primary evaluation metric across all experiments.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. LLMs (T5, PaLM) are mentioned as examples of models that show good generalization, but not used for evaluation.
The paper does not conduct any human evaluation. All evaluations are based on automatic exact match metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on compositional generalization in semantic parsing tasks. The extraction was generally accurate, though some metadata items needed normalization. The paper studies NLG (semantic parsing), uses automatic evaluation (exact match), but does not use LLMs as judges or conduct human evaluation. All experiments use English datasets and evaluate Transformer-based models on semantic parsing tasks.
